# SimpleAudit

Lightweight AI Safety Auditing Framework

> https://github.com/SushantGautam/simpleaudit

## Guides

- [Getting Started](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/getting-started/): Installation, environment setup, and first audit run.
- [Core Architecture](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/core-architecture/): System design, data flow, and module interactions.
- [CLI Usage](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/cli-usage/): Command-line interface options, flags, and execution modes.
- [Judges](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/judges/): Evaluation criteria, abstention logic, and custom judge implementation.
- [Judge Validation](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/judge-validation/): Meta-evaluation techniques to verify judge reliability and bias.
- [Cross-Judge Validation](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/cross-judge-validation/): Comparing judge outputs and validating consistency across evaluators.
- [Scenarios](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/scenarios/): Test case definitions, domain-specific packs, and scenario creation guidelines.
- [Results & Analysis](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/results-analysis/): Data structures, result aggregation, and statistical analysis.
- [Visualization](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/visualization/): Interactive dashboard server and result exploration tools.
- [Reframing & Advanced Workflows](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/reframing-advanced-workflows/): Prompt reframing strategies and complex experimental setups.

## API Reference

- [simpleaudit](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit/): Top-level package: the public API of SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.cli](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_cli/): Command-line interface (`simpleaudit` entry point).
- [simpleaudit.cross_judge](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_cross_judge/): Cross-judge experiments: score the same outputs with different judges and compare.
- [simpleaudit.experiment](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_experiment/): Batch experiments: run audits across multiple models and compare them.
- [simpleaudit.judge_the_judge](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judge_the_judge/): Judge validation: 'wiggle' the judge's inputs to measure judge robustness.
- [simpleaudit.judges](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges/): Built-in judge configurations: safety, harm, factuality, helpfulness, abstention, and more.
- [simpleaudit.judges.abstention](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_abstention/): Abstention judge: detects when the model should have refused/abstained.
- [simpleaudit.judges.binary_abstention](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_binary_abstention/): Binary abstention judge: yes/no abstention classification.
- [simpleaudit.judges.factuality](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_factuality/): Factuality judge: scores factual accuracy of model outputs.
- [simpleaudit.judges.harm](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_harm/): Harm judge: scores harmfulness of model outputs.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helpfulness](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_helpfulness/): Helpfulness judge: scores how helpful the model was.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helsedir_sexhealth_no](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_helsedir_sexhealth_no/): Helsedir sex-health (NO) judge: domain-specific Norwegian health judge.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helsedir_sexhealth_no_rag](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_helsedir_sexhealth_no_rag/): Helsedir sex-health (NO) RAG judge: grounded variant with retrieval context.
- [simpleaudit.judges.judge_conviction](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_judge_conviction/): Judge conviction: meta-judge that extracts the candidate judge's current verdict for cross-checking.
- [simpleaudit.judges.safety](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_safety/): Safety judge: scores safety of model outputs.
- [simpleaudit.model_auditor](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_model_auditor/): The core audit engine: drives target model, auditor, and judge across scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.reframing](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_reframing/): Reframing checks: rephrase a prompt and verify the model's answer stays consistent.
- [simpleaudit.repeated_results](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_repeated_results/): Stability analysis: repeated runs, fragility thresholds, and model stability reports.
- [simpleaudit.results](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_results/): Result containers: per-scenario results and aggregated audit results with summaries.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios/): Scenario packs: curated test suites (health, safety, government, benchmarks).
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.bullshitbench_health](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_bullshitbench_health/): BullshitBench health variant: non-informative medical answers.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.bullshitbench_v1_v2](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_bullshitbench_v1_v2/): BullshitBench v1/v2 scenarios: measuring non-informative answers.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.health](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_health/): Health domain scenarios: medical Q&A and advice tests.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.hei_refusal](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_hei_refusal/): HEI refusal scenarios: Norwegian youth-advice Q&A (16 refusal + 31 guidance scenarios).
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.helfo](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_helfo/): Helfo scenarios: Norwegian health insurance authority tests.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.helpmed](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_helpmed/): HelpMed scenarios: medical help-seeking tests.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.images.make_images](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_images_make_images/)
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.judge_the_judge](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_judge_the_judge/): Judge-the-judge scenarios: probes used to validate judges.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.lanekassen](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_lanekassen/): Lanekassen scenarios: Norwegian pension institution tests.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.nav_aap](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_nav_aap/): NAV AAP scenarios: Norwegian disability benefit tests.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.rag](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_rag/): RAG scenarios: retrieval-augmented generation tests.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.safety](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_safety/): Safety scenarios: refusal and harmful-request tests.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.skatteetaten](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_skatteetaten/): Skatteetaten scenarios: Norwegian tax authority tests.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.system_prompt](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_system_prompt/): System-prompt scenarios: tests of system prompt adherence.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.ung](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_ung/): UNG scenarios: youth health service tests.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.vision_integrity](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_vision_integrity/): Vision integrity scenarios: image-based integrity tests.
- [simpleaudit.utils](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_utils/): Shared helpers: LLM client wrappers, JSON parsing, and misc utilities.
- [simpleaudit.visualization.server](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_visualization_server/): FastAPI visualization server: browse audit results in a browser.
- [simpleaudit.judges](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges/): Built-in judge configurations: safety, harm, factuality, helpfulness, abstention, and more.
- [simpleaudit.judges.abstention](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_abstention/): Abstention judge: detects when the model should have refused/abstained.
- [simpleaudit.judges.binary_abstention](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_binary_abstention/): Binary abstention judge: yes/no abstention classification.
- [simpleaudit.judges.factuality](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_factuality/): Factuality judge: scores factual accuracy of model outputs.
- [simpleaudit.judges.harm](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_harm/): Harm judge: scores harmfulness of model outputs.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helpfulness](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_helpfulness/): Helpfulness judge: scores how helpful the model was.

- [simpleaudit.judges.helsedir_sexhealth_no_rag](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_helsedir_sexhealth_no_rag/): Helsedir sex-health (NO) RAG judge: grounded variant with retrieval context.

- [simpleaudit.scenarios.bullshitbench_v1_v2](https://sushantgautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_bullshitbench_v1_v2/): BullshitBench v1/v2 scenarios: measuring non-informative answers.
